Name: Horam, King of Gezer
Summary: Horam was king of Gezer when he came up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him and his people down until none remained.
KeyStory: Horam marched to Lachish's aid too late, and Joshua destroyed him and his army on the spot.
LifeLesson: Coming to the aid of a lost cause does not make it won.
